title: Local structure of a quotient of a local ring
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative local ring and let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ be an ideal. Then $A/I$ is a nonzero local ring, its maximal ideal is the image $\mathfrak m/I$, and the quotient map $A\to A/I$ is local.
